scripts.lint: bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:eslint && bun run lint:oxfmt
scripts.start: turbo run build && (bun run --cwd apps/api start & PORT=5174 bun run --cwd apps/web start & bun scripts/local-proxy.ts & wait)
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test:coverage && mkdir -p coverage && bun scripts/normalize-lcov.ts $(find apps packages -name 'lcov.info' -path '*/coverage/*') && lcov-result-merger '{apps,packages}/*/coverage/**/lcov.info' coverage/lcov.info
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run test:integration && bun run knip
scripts.postinstall: test -n "$CI" || test -n "$DOCKER_CONTAINER" || env | grep -q ^DEPENDABOT || lefthook install

//overrides.all: Patch vulnerable transitive deps. Run `bun audit` after removing any to check if still needed. These notes sit outside `overrides` because bun records that block verbatim into bun.lock: bun >= 1.4 strips `//` keys when reading package.json but not when reading the lockfile, so a comment key inside `overrides` fails --frozen-lockfile in the Docker build.
//overrides.@tanstack/query-core: Dedupe: query-db-collection and router-ssr-query peer-resolve an older query-core; TS treats identical-but-different-path type copies as distinct, collapsing createCollection generics to Record<string, unknown>.
//overrides.hono, @hono/node-server: shadcn's MCP SDK brings its own hono stack. The pins dedupe it onto the version apps/api uses and keep node-server off the 1.19.x line, whose serve-static path traversal on Windows is unpatched before 1.19.15.
//overrides.html2canvas: Redirect jspdf's optional html2canvas dep to html2canvas-pro (the version we already use directly). Keep this pin in step with html2canvas-pro in apps/web: dependabot does not treat an npm: alias as the same package, so a mismatch silently ships both versions as separate chunks. Enforced by scripts/check-override-pins.ts.
//overrides.kysely: Dedupe: better-auth pins kysely 0.29.2 while the api uses 0.29.5; two kysely copies fork @better-auth/core into two identical-but-different-path type copies, breaking the api build.
